effects.effect: The reaver has [cover](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cover) while [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to another reaver they were summoned with. Whenever they receive an effect that allows them to move or [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) outside of their move action, they share the effect with each [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) reaver they were summoned with.

The reaver's [free strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) inflict M < WEAK [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) (save ends). Each time the reaver inflicts [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) on a creature, they can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) 2 and make an additional [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) on a new target.

flavor: Iron reavers are long, gnashing lines of centipede-like bladed legs. Their bodies endlessly shed metal shavings and hard sheets of iron as they move.
name: Iron Reaver
